question: _________ is NOT a tributary of the river Ganga.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Sutlej**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Sutlej** is a tributary of **River Indus**.
 
• Shutudri is the name of the river mentioned during Vedic age.
 
• It starts from Lake Rakshastal and is a major river among the five rivers of Punjab.
